name: appearance
description: The theme preset, the scheme and the design tokens as hub settings (ADR 0035), checked before they are saved and resolved per device for every surface.

settings.label: Theme
settings.help: The preset: Vyre's own, or one a module installs. Each has a dark and a paper scheme.

settings.label: Scheme
settings.help: Follow the device, or always dark or paper.

settings.label: Design tokens
settings.help: A partial tokens file merged over the preset. Checked before it is saved; the whole change is refused, naming the failing pair.
